summary: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Morrish Road, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services has reviewed the need for pedestrian crossing protection at Morrish Road and Euclid Avenue. Based on the assessment undertaken, Transportation Services does not recommend the installation of pedestrian crossing protection at Morrish Road and Euclid Avenue as the warrant criteria was not met for a pedestrian crossover (PXO).
decided: City Council on May 5 and 6, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the installation of a pedestrian crossover at Morrish Road and Euclid Avenue.

text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Morrish Road, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services has reviewed the need for pedestrian crossing protection at Morrish Road and Euclid Avenue. Based on the assessment undertaken, Transportation Services does not recommend the installation of pedestrian crossing protection at Morrish Road and Euclid Avenue as the warrant criteria was not met for a pedestrian crossover (PXO).
City Council on May 5 and 6, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the installation of a pedestrian crossover at Morrish Road and Euclid Avenue.
